resources.string: Pick MotionCam\'s folder once (usually Documents/MotionCam): its .mcraw files show here and are developed into the log chosen above when imported. A quick half-size develop goes on the timeline first; the full one replaces it by itself.
MotionCam RAW can\'t be read on this phone (the decoder library didn\'t load).
